variant.description: Provides a configurable overlay, configurable alerts, and a powerful rule system for displaying how many currency (or non-currency) items you have (or don't have). A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
variant.name: Currency Watchdog
variant.punchline: Shows an overlay and/or sends alerts when your held currency items (or non-currency items) match configurable rules. A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
